_about: The race view's sounds (race-view/race-sound.js), in sections (owner, 13 Nov 2026), made from his recordings by tools/sound/mix_real_sounds.py (the sources and what each file is are listed there). Before the off: crowd-murmur (loop), the crowd waiting. The off: off.mp3, one sound, the stalls opening laid into the Cheltenham roar with its 'and they're off'; started so its latches click at the off (off.latchAt seconds in); the crowd's loops are turned down to off.duck until off.duckUntil. The middle: middle.mp3 (loop), the crowd a little muted, the field galloping, the commentator in the background; it fades in from sections.middleFrom seconds into the race over sections.middleIn, and fades out over sections.cross as the finish comes in. The finish: finish.mp3, started so the line (finish.lineAt seconds in) comes as the leader crosses it: about 3 furlongs out; the crowd and the commentator more and more animated, the surge at the line, then applause. After the race the crowd waiting comes back sections.murmurBack seconds after the line. A long race passing the stands with more than sections.passingFrom metres still to run lifts the crowd (crowd-excited, by crowd.passingStands). gallop.mp3 (loop) adds the horses up close: on close shots (by how near the shot looks: hooves.*) and in the slow-motion replay. files: each sound; 'loop' is a loop's exact length in seconds (the file carries half a second of it either side; the script writes these); 'bus': crowd (louder and clearer when the camera is near the crowd, muffled from a distant start: crowd.nearFrom/farAt/farLevel/farMuffle), hooves (by the shot), or master (as it is). mix: each layer's loudest level.
